steps.input:
python3 - <<'PY'
n=19
centers=[(3,6,8),(4,13,4),(12,14,1),(14,3,2)]
# map original 3 arms to their owning colored cross, empty plus None
owner={}
for r,c,v in centers:
 for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]: owner[(r+dr,c+dc)]=(r,c)
for p in [(9,8),(10,7),(10,9),(11,8)]: owner[p]=None
marks=set(owner)
H={}; V={}
for r,c,color in centers:
 for dr,dc,dest in [(0,-1,H),(0,1,H),(-1,0,V),(1,0,V)]:
  i,j=r+dr,c+dc
  first=True
  while 0<=i<n and 0<=j<n:
   if (i,j) in marks:
    # own immediate arm lies on ray, may be traversed; any other marker blocks.
    if owner[(i,j)]==(r,c) and first:
     i+=dr;j+=dc;first=False;continue
    break
   # other colored center is not a 3 but terminates ray
   if any((i,j)==(rr,cc) for rr,cc,_ in centers): break
   dest[(i,j)]=color
   i+=dr;j+=dc;first=False
# H first then V precedence, restore marks and centers
out=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for (i,j),v in H.items():out[i][j]=v
for (i,j),v in V.items():out[i][j]=v
for i,j in marks:out[i][j]=3
for r,c,v in centers:out[r][c]=v
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
print('{"action":"submit","grid":'+str(out).replace(' ','')+'}')
PY
